1. Who we are

Kirana Mart is a mobile application that connects customers with local kirana (grocery) shops in India, with optional delivery via independent delivery partners. The App is currently operated by Sudhir Davim. Kirana Mart is in beta and not yet available to the general public.

We are a marketplace platform. We do not own, stock, or sell the products listed in the App. Each shop owner sets their own prices, manages their own inventory, and is responsible for the quality of the goods they sell.

2. Acceptance of these Terms

You accept these Terms by:

  • Tapping "Send OTP" on the sign-in screen, or

If you are using the App on behalf of a shop or a delivery business, you confirm that you have authority to bind that entity to these Terms.

3. Your account

3.1 Phone number and OTP

Your phone number is your account identifier. The one-time password (OTP) we send during sign-in is the credential that proves you own that number.

You are responsible for:

  • Keeping your OTP confidential — never share it with anyone, including someone claiming to be from Kirana Mart support.
  • Keeping your phone number current. If you change numbers, contact us to migrate your account.
  • All activity that occurs under your phone number until you sign out or notify us of unauthorized access.

3.2 One shop per owner

Each shop owner may operate one shop on Kirana Mart. This is enforced server-side. Attempting to register multiple shops under a single account, or under separate accounts controlled by the same person, is a violation of these Terms and may result in suspension of all related accounts.

3.3 Account types

The App supports four account roles:

  • Customer — places orders.
  • Shop owner — operates one shop, manages menu and orders.
  • Delivery partner — accepts and delivers orders from any shop.
  • Admin — Kirana Mart operations team. Customer accounts cannot self-elevate to admin.

Your role is provisioned by Kirana Mart and cannot be changed by you. Contact support if you need to switch roles.

4. Permitted use

You may use the App to:

  • As a customer: browse shops, place orders, pay for and receive groceries, rate and review shops.
  • As a shop owner: list your menu, accept orders, fulfil them honestly, communicate with customers and delivery partners.
  • As a delivery partner: accept available pickups, deliver them in good faith, communicate honestly with customers and shops.

All users agree to act in good faith, treat each other with respect, and follow Indian law.

5. Prohibited use

You may not use the App to:

  • Defraud another user (e.g. take payment and not deliver, accept an order with no intent to fulfil, claim a delivery you did not make).
  • Impersonate another person or entity, or use a phone number you do not own.

We reserve the right to suspend or terminate any account that we reasonably believe is engaged in prohibited use.

6. Orders, payments, and refunds

6.1 Order placement

Placing an order creates a binding request to purchase the items in your cart from the selected shop at the listed prices.

6.2 Payment methods

Kirana Mart supports two payment methods:

  • Cash on Delivery (COD) — pay the delivery partner directly on receipt.
  • Online payment via Razorpay — UPI, card, net banking, and wallet options handled by Razorpay. Kirana Mart never sees or stores your card or bank details — see our Privacy Policy §2.5.

6.3 Self-cancellation

You may cancel a pending online-payment order within 2 minutes of placing it if the shop has not yet accepted. After acceptance, cancellation requires contacting the shop or Kirana Mart support. COD orders may be cancelled until the shop accepts.

6.4 Refunds

For online-payment orders that we cancel (out-of-stock items, shop non-acceptance, delivery failure), refunds are initiated via Razorpay and typically credit back to your original payment method within 5–7 business days. Refunds for items received but defective are handled case-by-case by Kirana Mart support — email us with the order ID and a photo.

See our Privacy Policy §payment for details on payment data handling.

7. Pricing and availability

Prices in the App are set by individual shop owners and may change without notice. The price displayed at checkout is the price you pay (plus delivery fees if any).

Inventory is dynamic — items shown as available at browse time may be out of stock by the time the shop processes your order. When this happens, the shop follows your substitution preference (set at checkout):

  • Call me — the shop phones you to discuss.
  • Replace — the shop substitutes a comparable item.
  • Refund — the shop refunds the missing item.

This preference is captured per-order; the default for legacy orders is "Call me".

8. Delivery

Delivery is performed by independent delivery partners, not employees of Kirana Mart. We do not employ, dispatch, or control delivery partners directly; the App matches them to available pickups.

Delivery time estimates ("Ready by HH:MM", "expected delivery in X minutes") are good-faith estimates based on the shop's signal and recent partner activity. Delays do not give rise to penalty claims against Kirana Mart, the shop, or the delivery partner, except in cases of clear bad faith (e.g. delivery partner accepted a pickup and never collected it, despite repeated reminders).

If your order is materially late or never arrives, contact Kirana Mart support; we mediate refunds in good faith.

We may moderate or remove reviews that violate these Terms or that appear to be coordinated review manipulation.
